title: Field Caches
subtitle: Small rewards that make the next route safer
summary: Field caches should support survival, tech repair, map intel, or route preparation without skipping progression.
body: The first survivor cache should feel useful without becoming a permanent exploit. Good rewards include food, filters, repair parts, and route notes.
Cache markers should be low-risk early and clearly separate from dangerous ruin markers.
After sweeping a cache, return to Terminal so Reward Inbox and What Now can update.
